g.text: MAIN PIPE RACK PR-100 - TIER ALLOCATION
1. Typical bent; bents at 6.0 m centres (12 m portal over RD-W). Steel HE400B columns, HE300A beams.
2. Line sizes indicative: from pump rated flow at 2.0 m/s (liquid); final sizes per line list.
3. Hot lines (> 260 C) on tier 1 with expansion loops on tier 3 level; flare header
4. on tier 3 free-draining to D-104 (1:500). CWS/CWR heavy lines tier 1 outer positions.
5. Cable trays (EL / IC) on south cantilever brackets, segregated from hot lines; fireproofed
6. rack steel to EL 111.0 below air coolers per API 2218 (to be confirmed by fire study).
7. Pump CL 3.5 m (north) / 4.5 m (south) off rack edge; drivers accessible from under-rack aisle (ER-1).
8. Headroom under tier 1 = EL 106.0 - beam - road crown >= 5.0 m (no mobile crane under rack).
AIR COOLER BAY (TYP. A-104, 6 m x 12 m, FORCED DRAFT)
TYPICAL BENT CROSS-SECTION (LOOKING WEST ALONG RACK) - SCALE 1:50
Hot process lines (B2/B3), crude, residue, pumparounds
Product, cold HC, sour water, OSBL product lines
Utilities: steam/condensate, CW, FG, N2, IA, flare header
Cable trays EL power + IC (south brackets)
Utilities on tier 3 include steam headers with expansion loops;
loops for tier-1 hot lines raised to tier 3 level at loop bays.
